photo.title: A Kota Mahongwe reliquary guardian figure or Bwete formed of a shaft with a metal leaf-shaped plate covered with strips of brass and copper wire. On the facing side of the figure is a nose like projection and two missing eyes.

A carved white Kota Emboli mask with frontal and median projections at the top of the head with a plume of black feathers at the tip. At the base of the mask is a raffia fringe. The mask is decorated with red and black dots and with large red eyes. On display in a museum.
A graphic information panel showing two different types of Kota reliquary guardian figures; Kota-Obamba and Kota-Mahongwe types.

Sickle. With a curved metal blade set into a wooden handle. The blade expands and curves to a pointed tip. The inner edge of the blade is the cutting edge, the blade is blunt at the handle and tip. The handle is cylindrical, the tang is exposed at the handle terminal. [AB [OPS Move] 8/12/2016]
